scripts.fonts:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const s='fonts',d='dist/fonts';fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(s).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.woff2')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(p.join(s,f),p.join(d,f)));console.log('Copied WOFF2 fonts to dist/fonts/')"
scripts.build: npm run tw:build && npm run css:build && npm run fonts:copy
